title: Sava A7L Pro!!!

takeaways.text: Coming from an old Giant TCR, the 93 kg rider finds the A7L Pro very stiff and snappy; the seatpost slipped once on the first ride despite its anti-slip coating.
28 mm Continental GP5000 S TR tires (with TPU tubes) fit with plenty of room at the front and a tighter rear; he guesses 30 mm might fit with some brands. SAVA's stated R08 maximum is 25C.
SAVA support confirmed the R08 frame; at 175 cm he rides the 51 cm size, where he would choose a 54 cm in Western brands.
He paid about US$1,800 delivered with a coupon; it shipped from California and arrived in about three and a half days.

disclosure: Owner video; he bought the bike himself with a coupon and no sponsorship is stated.
summary: A US owner's walkaround of his size-51 SAVA A7L Pro after a few weeks, focused on tire fit, sizing and delivery.
